statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the UAS did not find a matching transaction for the CANCEL according to the procedure above, it SHOULD respond to the CANCEL with a 481 (Call Leg/Transaction Does Not Exist).
actions: send 481 (Call Leg/Transaction Does Not Exist) response to CANCEL

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the original request was an INVITE, the UAS SHOULD immediately respond to the INVITE with a 487 (Request Terminated).
statements.pre_cond: matching_transaction != null & original_request.method = INVITE & final_response_sent = false
actions: immediately send 487 (Request Terminated) response to INVITE

statements.subject: message
statements.description: This response is constructed following the procedures described in Section 8.2.6 noting that the To tag of the response to the CANCEL and the To tag in the response to the original request SHOULD be the same.
